description: The pre-trade check in one call for a Robinhood Chain token: clear (no rule-based blocker) or the blockers and warnings, each named, with the readings behind them — the verdict with its reasons, the deployer's record, holder concentration, the market with its main pool (kind, hook, quote, depth in range), a simulated sell test in that pool (on the newest block's state a fresh address buys about 0.03 ETH, or about 100 USDG in a USDG pool, through the public routers and sells 200 simulated blocks later the way a wallet sells through them; nothing is sent; class sellable means 90 % or more of what was paid came back in the simulation; unknown means not tested: treat it as untested, never as sellable, and clear can be true while it is unknown; a simulation, not a fill: it does not see an operator reacting to a real buyer, a longer lock or a larger order, and a sale a token allows only after a new block reads as reverted, because the block number a contract reads does not move in a simulation), the measured X callers who named the token (coordinated clusters count once), the contract template. Free under a daily per-IP cap of 100, $0.02 over x402 past it, every plan key covers it. Rule-based observations, never a recommendation.
name: robinx_check
title: Pre-trade check (one call)
